### `LuaUndoRedoStack`

The undo queue for a player. The term `item_index` refers to the index of an undo item in the queue, while `action_index` refers to the index of one of the individual actions that make up an undo item. Items are added to the undo queue through pla...

**Methods:**

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|--------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `get_redo_item()` | `index`: uint32 | array[UndoRedoAction] | Gets an undo item from the redo stack. |
| `get_redo_item_count()` | — | uint32 | The number of undo items in the redo stack. |
| `get_redo_tag()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32, `tag_name`: string | AnyBasic | Gets the tag with the given name from a specific redo item action, or `nil` if it doesn't exist. |
| `get_redo_tags()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32 | Tags | Gets all tags for the given redo action. |
| `get_undo_item()` | `index`: uint32 | array[UndoRedoAction] | Gets an undo item from the undo stack. |
| `get_undo_item_count()` | — | uint32 | The number undo items in the undo stack. |
| `get_undo_tag()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32, `tag_name`: string | AnyBasic | Gets the tag with the given name from a specific undo item action, or `nil` if it doesn't exist. |
| `get_undo_tags()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32 | Tags | Gets all tags for the given undo action. |
| `remove_redo_action()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32 | void | Removes an undo action from the specified undo item on the redo stack. |
| `remove_redo_item()` | `index`: uint32 | void | Removes an undo item from the redo stack. |
| `remove_redo_tag()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32, `tag`: string | boolean | Removes a tag with the given name from the specified redo item. |
| `remove_undo_action()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32 | void | Removes an undo action from the specified undo item on the undo stack. |
| `remove_undo_item()` | `index`: uint32 | void | Removes an undo item from the undo stack. |
| `remove_undo_tag()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32, `tag`: string | boolean | Removes a tag with the given name from the specified undo item. |
| `set_redo_tag()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32, `tag`: AnyBasic, `tag_name`: string | void | Sets a new tag with the given name and value on the specified redo item action. |
| `set_undo_tag()` | `action_index`: uint32, `item_index`: uint32, `tag`: AnyBasic, `tag_name`: string | void | Sets a new tag with the given name and value on the specified undo item action. |

### `LuaWireConnector`

A wire connector of a given entity. Allows to find wires, add or remove wires and do some basic operations specific to those connectors.

**Methods:**

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|--------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `can_wire_reach()` | `other_connector`: LuaWireConnector | LuaEntity | boolean | Checks if a wire can reach from this connector to the other connector. |
| `connect_to()` | `origin?`: defines.wire_origin, `reach_check?`: boolean, `target`: LuaWireConnector | boolean | Connects this connector to other wire connector. |
| `disconnect_all()` | `origin?`: defines.wire_origin | boolean | Removes all wires going out of this wire connector. |
| `disconnect_from()` | `origin?`: defines.wire_origin, `target`: LuaWireConnector | boolean | Disconnects this connector from other wire connector. |
| `have_common_neighbour()` | `ignore_ghost_neighbours?`: boolean, `other_connector`: LuaWireConnector | boolean | Checks if this and other wire connector have a common neighbour. |
| `is_connected_to()` | `origin?`: defines.wire_origin, `target`: LuaWireConnector | boolean | Checks if this connector has any wire going to the other connector. |

**Attributes:**

| Attribute | Type | RW | Description |
|-----------|------|----|-------------|
| `connection_count` | `uint32` | R | Amount of wires going out of this connector. It includes all wires (ghost wires and real wires). |
| `connections` | `array[WireConnection]` | R | All wire connectors this connector is connected to. It includes all wires (ghost wires and real wires). |
| `is_ghost` | `boolean` | R | If this connector is owned by an entity inside of a ghost. If any of 2 ends of a wire attaches to a ghost connector, then a wire is considered to be a ghost. |
| `network_id` | `uint32` | R | Index of a CircuitNetwork or ElectricSubNetwork which is going through this wire connector. Returns 0 if there is no network associated with this wire connector right now. CircuitNetwork indexes are independent of indexes of ElectricSubNetwork so ... |
| `object_name` | `string` | R | The class name of this object. Available even when `valid` is false. For LuaStruct objects it may also be suffixed with a dotted path to a member of the struct. |
| `owner` | `LuaEntity` | R | The entity this wire connector belongs to. May return entity ghost instead if this wire connector belongs to inner entity. |
| `real_connection_count` | `uint32` | R | Amount of real wires going out of this connector. It only includes wires for which both wire connectors are real (not ghosts). |
| `real_connections` | `array[WireConnection]` | R | All wire connectors this connector is connected to with real wires. It only includes wires that are between two non-ghost entities. |
| `valid` | `boolean` | R | Is this object valid? This Lua object holds a reference to an object within the game engine. It is possible that the game-engine object is removed whilst a mod still holds the corresponding Lua object. If that happens, the object becomes invalid, ... |
| `wire_connector_id` | `defines.wire_connector_id` | R | Identifier of this connector in the entity this connector belongs to. |
| `wire_type` | `defines.wire_type` | R | The type of wires that can be connected to this connector. |

| `on_area_cloned` | `clear_destination_decoratives`, `clear_destination_entities`, `clone_decoratives`, `clone_entities`, `clone_tiles`, `destination_area`, `destination_force`, `destination_surface`, `name`, `source_area`, `source_surface`, `tick` | Called when an area of the map is cloned. |

## 6. Prototypes

There are **278** data-stage prototypes. These define entity/item/recipe types in `data.extend({...})`.

### `AccumulatorPrototype` *(extends `EntityWithOwnerPrototype`)*

Entity with energy source with specialised animation for charging/discharging. Used for the accumulator entity.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `chargable_graphics` | `ChargableGraphics` |  |  |
| `circuit_connector` | `CircuitConnectorDefinition` |  |  |
| `circuit_wire_max_distance` | `double` |  | The maximum circuit wire distance for this entity. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `default_output_signal` | `SignalIDConnector` |  | The name of the signal that is the default for when an accumulator is connected to the circuit network. |
| `draw_circuit_wires` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `draw_copper_wires` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `energy_source` | `ElectricEnergySource` |  | The capacity of the energy source buffer specifies the capacity of the accumulator. |

---

### `AchievementPrototype` *(extends `Prototype`)*

This prototype definition is used for the in-game achievements.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `allowed_without_fight` | `boolean` |  | If this is set to `false`, it is not possible to complete the achievement on the peaceful difficulty setting or when the enemy base generation settings have been changed. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `icon` | `FileName` |  | Path to the icon file. Only loaded, and mandatory if `icons` is not defined. |
| `icon_size` | `SpriteSizeType` |  | The size of the square icon, in pixels. E.g. `32` for a 32px by 32px icon. Must be larger than `0`. The base game uses 128px icons for achievements. Only loaded if `icons` is not defined. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 64}`)* |
| `icons` | `array[IconData]` |  | Can't be an empty array. |
| `steam_stats_name` | `string` |  | Unusable by mods, as this refers to unlocking the achievement through Steam. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |

---

Required for `"complete-objective-achievement"`, `"dont-build-entity-achievement"`, and `"dont-craft-manually-achievement"`. Not allowed for `"dont-kill-manually-achievement"` and `"do... |

### `BeaconPrototype` *(extends `EntityWithOwnerPrototype`)*

Entity with the ability to transfer module effects to its neighboring entities.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |

| `allowed_effects` | `EffectTypeLimitation` |  | The types of modules that a player can place inside of the beacon. *(default: `No effects are allowed`)* |

| `base_picture` | `Animation` |  | Only loaded if `graphics_set` is not defined. The picture of the beacon when it is not on. |
| `beacon_counter` | `'total' | 'same_type'` |  | The beacon counter used by effect receiver when deciding which sample to take from `profile`. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'total'}`)* |
| `distribution_effectivity` | `double` |  | The multiplier of the module's effects, when shared between neighbors. |
| `distribution_effectivity_bonus_per_quality_level` | `double` |  | Must be 0 or positive. |
| `energy_source` | `ElectricEnergySource | VoidEnergySource` |  |  |
| `energy_usage` | `Energy` |  | The constant power usage of this beacon. |
| `graphics_set` | `BeaconGraphicsSet` |  | The graphics for the beacon. |
| `module_slots` | `ItemStackIndex` |  | The number of module slots in this beacon. |
| `perceived_performance` | `PerceivedPerformance` |  | Affects animation speed. |
| `profile` | `array[double]` |  | Extra multiplier applied to the effects received from beacon by the effect receiver based on amount of beacons that are in range of that effect receiver. If there are more beacons that reach the effect receiver than there are entries in this array... |
| `quality_affects_module_slots` | `boolean` |  | If set, QualityPrototype::beacon_module_slots_bonus will be added to module slots count. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `quality_affects_supply_area_distance` | `boolean` |  | If set, QualityPrototype::beacon_supply_area_distance_bonus will be added to supply_area_distance. Total value will be clamped to be within range `[0, 64]`. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `radius_visualisation_picture` | `Sprite` |  |  |
| `supply_area_distance` | `uint32` |  | The maximum distance that this beacon can supply its neighbors with its module's effects. Max distance is 64. |

### `CraftingMachinePrototype` *(extends `EntityWithOwnerPrototype`)* *(abstract)*

The abstract basis of the assembling machines and furnaces. Contains the properties that both of them have. Note that a crafting machine cannot be rotated unless it has at least one of the following: a fluid box, a heat energy source, a fluid ener...

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `allowed_effects` | `EffectTypeLimitation` |  | Sets the modules and beacon effects that are allowed to be used on this machine. *(default: `No effects are allowed`)* |
| `allowed_module_categories` | `array[ModuleCategoryID]` |  | Sets the module categories that are allowed to be inserted into this machine. *(default: `All module categories are allowed`)* |

| `alternative_key_sequence` | `string` |  | The alternative key binding for this control. See `key_sequence` for the format. |
| `block_modifiers` | `boolean` |  | If `true`, when the shortcut is activated, the modifiers used for this shortcut can't be re-used to press something else until unpressed. The example where this is useful is ALT+A to activate spidertron remote, where ALT is consumed, so pressing r... *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `consuming` | `ConsumingType` |  | Sets whether internal game events associated with the same key sequence should be fired or blocked. If they are fired ("none"), then the custom input event will happen before the internal game event. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'none'}`)* |
| `controller_alternative_key_sequence` | `string` |  | The alternative controller (game pad) keybinding for this control. See `controller_key_sequence` for the format. |
| `controller_key_sequence` | `string` |  | The controller (game pad) keybinding for this control. Use `""` (empty string) for unassigned. As modifier buttons, these names are used: `"controller-righttrigger"`, `"controller-lefttrigger"`. `" + "` is used to separate modifier buttons from no... |
| `enabled` | `boolean` |  | If this custom input is enabled. Disabled custom inputs exist but are not used by the game. If disabled, no event is raised when the input is used. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `enabled_while_in_cutscene` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `enabled_while_spectating` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `include_selected_prototype` | `boolean` |  | If true, the type and name of the currently selected prototype will be provided as "selected_prototype" in the raised Lua event. This also works in GUIs, not just the game world. This will also return an item in the cursor such as copper-wire or r... *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `item_to_spawn` | `ItemID` |  | The item will be created when this input is pressed and action is set to "spawn-item". The item must have the spawnable flag set. |

| `linked_game_control` | `LinkedGameControl` |  | When a custom-input is linked to a game control it won't show up in the control-settings GUI and will fire when the linked control is pressed. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `name` | `string` |  | Unique textual identification of the prototype. May only contain alphanumeric characters, dashes and underscores. May not exceed a length of 200 characters. For a list of all names used in vanilla, see data.raw. It is also the name for the event t... |

When decoratives are being spawned by EnemySpawnerPrototype::spawn_decoration or TurretPrototype::spawn_decoration, decals with `decal_overdraw_priority` greater than 0 will be filtered such that they don'... *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |

| `opacity_over_water` | `float` |  | Loaded only if `render_layer` = "decals". Value lower than 1 enables masking by water for decals with `tile_layer` greater or equal to UtilityConstants::capture_water_mask_at_layer. Water tiles must use water `tile-effect` with WaterTileEffectPara... *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `pictures` | `SpriteVariations` |  | Must contain at least 1 picture. |
| `placed_effect` | `TriggerEffect` |  |  |

| `damage_type` | `DamageTypeID` |  | This defines how the player needs to destroy the specific entity. |
| `in_vehicle` | `boolean` |  | This defines if the player needs to be in a vehicle. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `personally` | `boolean` |  | This defines to make sure you are the one driving, for instance, in a tank rather than an automated train. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `to_kill` | `EntityID | array[EntityID]` |  | This defines which entity needs to be destroyed in order to receive the achievement. |
| `type_to_kill` | `string` |  | This defines what entity type needs to be destroyed in order to receive the achievement. |

### `LoaderPrototype` *(extends `TransportBeltConnectablePrototype`)* *(abstract)*

Continuously loads and unloads machines, as an alternative to inserters.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `adjustable_belt_stack_size` | `boolean` |  | Loader belt stack size can be adjusted at runtime. Requires LoaderPrototype::max_belt_stack_size to be > 1. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `allow_container_interaction` | `boolean` |  | Whether this loader can load and unload stationary inventories such as containers and crafting machines. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `allow_rail_interaction` | `boolean` |  | Whether this loader can load and unload RollingStockPrototype. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `belt_length` | `double` |  | How long this loader's belt is. Should be the same as belt_distance, which is hardcoded to `0.5` for Loader1x2Prototype and to 0 for Loader1x1Prototype. See the linked prototypes for an explanation of belt_distance. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0.5}`)* |
| `circuit_connector` | `array[CircuitConnectorDefinition]` |  | First the four cardinal directions for `direction_out`, followed by the four directions for `direction_in`. |
| `circuit_connector_layer` | `RenderLayer` |  | Render layer for all directions of the circuit connectors. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'object'}`)* |
| `circuit_wire_max_distance` | `double` |  | The maximum circuit wire distance for this entity. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `container_distance` | `double` |  | The distance between the position of this loader and the tile of the loader's container target. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1.5}`)* |
| `draw_circuit_wires` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `draw_copper_wires` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `energy_per_item` | `Energy` |  | Energy in Joules. Can't be negative. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `energy_source` | `ElectricEnergySource | HeatEnergySource | FluidEnergySource | VoidEnergySource` |  |  |
| `filter_count` | `uint8` |  | How many item filters this loader has. Maximum count of filtered items in loader is 5. |
| `max_belt_stack_size` | `uint8` |  | Loader will not create stacks on belt that are larger than this value. Must be >= 1. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `per_lane_filters` | `boolean` |  | If filters are per lane. Can only be set to true if filter_count is equal to 2. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `respect_insert_limits` | `boolean` |  | When set, this loader will respect the same automated insertion limits as inserters do, instead of inserting up to the full ingredient stack capacity. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `structure` | `LoaderStructure` |  |  |
| `structure_render_layer` | `RenderLayer` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'object'}`)* |
| `wait_for_full_stack` | `boolean` |  | When set, this loader will ignore items for which there is not enough to create a full belt stack. Relevant only when loader can create belt stacks. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |

### `NamedNoiseExpression` *(extends `Prototype`)*

A NoiseExpression with a name. The base game uses named noise expressions to specify functions for many map properties to be used in map generation; e.g. the "elevation" expression is used to calculate elevation for every point on a map. For a lis...

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `expression` | `NoiseExpression` |  | The noise expression itself. This is where most of the noise magic happens. |
| `intended_property` | `string` |  | Names the property that this expression is intended to provide a value for, if any. This will make the expression show up as an option in the map generator GUI, unless it is the only expression with that intended property, in which case it will be... |
| `local_expressions` | `dict[string → NoiseExpression]` |  | A map of expression name to expression. Local expressions are meant to store data locally similar to local variables in Lua. Their purpose is to hold noise expressions used multiple times in the named noise expression, or just to tell the reader t... |
| `local_functions` | `dict[string → NoiseFunction]` |  | A map of function name to function. Local functions serve the same purpose as local expressions - they aren't visible outside of the specific prototype and they have access to other local definitions. |
| `order` | `Order` |  | Used to order alternative expressions in the map generator GUI. For a given property (e.g. 'temperature'), the NamedNoiseExpression with that property's name as its `intended_property` with the lowest order will be chosen as the default in the GUI... |

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `expression` | `NoiseExpression` |  |  |
| `local_expressions` | `dict[string → NoiseExpression]` |  | A map of expression name to expression. Local expressions are meant to store data locally similar to local variables in Lua. Their purpose is to hold noise expressions used multiple times in the named noise expression, or just to tell the reader t... |
| `local_functions` | `dict[string → NoiseFunction]` |  | A map of function name to function. Local functions serve the same purpose as local expressions - they aren't visible outside of the specific prototype and they have access to other local definitions. |
| `parameters` | `array[string]` |  | The order of the parameters matters because functions can also be called with positional arguments. A function can't have more than 255 parameters. |

|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `acceleration` | `double` |  | Must be != 0 if `turning_speed_increases_exponentially_with_projectile_speed` is true. |
| `action` | `Trigger` |  | Executed when the projectile hits something. |
| `animation` | `RotatedAnimationVariations` |  |  |
| `direction_only` | `boolean` |  | Setting this to true can be used to disable projectile homing behaviour. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `enable_drawing_with_mask` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `final_action` | `Trigger` |  | Executed when the projectile hits something, after `action` and only if the entity that was hit was destroyed. The projectile is destroyed right after the final_action. |
| `force_condition` | `ForceCondition` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'all'}`)* |
| `height` | `double` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `hit_at_collision_position` | `boolean` |  | When true the entity is hit at the position on its collision box the projectile first collides with. When false the entity is hit at its own position. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `hit_collision_mask` | `CollisionMaskConnector` |  | Defaults to the mask from UtilityConstants::default_collision_masks when indexed by `"projectile/hit"`. |
| `light` | `LightDefinition` |  |  |
| `max_speed` | `double` |  | Must be greater than or equal to 0. *(default: `MAX_DOUBLE`)* |
| `piercing_damage` | `float` |  | Whenever an entity is hit by the projectile, this number gets reduced by the health of the entity. If the number is then below 0, the `final_action` is applied and the projectile destroyed. Otherwise, the projectile simply continues to its destina... *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `rotatable` | `boolean` |  | Whether the animation of the projectile is rotated to match the direction of travel. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `shadow` | `RotatedAnimationVariations` |  |  |
| `smoke` | `array[SmokeSource]` |  |  |
| `speed_modifier` | `Vector` |  |  *(default: ``{1, 1}``)* |
| `turn_speed` | `float` |  | Must be greater than or equal to 0. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `turning_speed_increases_exponentially_with_projectile_speed` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |

### `PrototypeBase` *(abstract)*

The abstract base for prototypes. PrototypeBase defines the common features of prototypes, such as localization and order.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `factoriopedia_description` | `LocalisedString` |  | Provides additional description used in factoriopedia. |
| `factoriopedia_simulation` | `SimulationDefinition` |  | The simulation shown when looking at this prototype in the Factoriopedia GUI. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `hidden_in_factoriopedia` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `Value of `hidden``)* |
| `localised_description` | `LocalisedString` |  | Overwrites the description set in the locale file. The description is usually shown in the tooltip of the prototype. |
| `localised_name` | `LocalisedString` |  | Overwrites the name set in the locale file. Can be used to easily set a procedurally-generated name because the LocalisedString format allows to insert parameters into the name directly from the Lua script. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Unique textual identification of the prototype. May only contain alphanumeric characters, dashes and underscores. May not exceed a length of 200 characters. For a list of all names used in vanilla, see data.raw. |
| `order` | `Order` |  | Used to order prototypes in inventory, recipes and GUIs. May not exceed a length of 200 characters. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `parameter` | `boolean` |  | Whether the prototype is a special type which can be used to parametrize blueprints and doesn't have other function. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `subgroup` | `ItemSubGroupID` |  | The name of an ItemSubGroup. |
| `type` | `string` |  | Specifies the kind of prototype this is. For a list of all possible types, see the prototype overview. |

### `QualityPrototype` *(extends `Prototype`)*

One quality step. Its effects are specified by the level and the various multiplier and bonus properties. Properties ending in `_multiplier` are applied multiplicatively to their base property, properties ending in `_bonus` are applied additively.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `accumulator_capacity_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `1 + `level``)* |
| `asteroid_collector_collection_radius_bonus` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0. Performance warning: the navigation has to pre-calculate ranges for the highest tier collector possible, so you should keep this collection radius within reasonable values. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `beacon_module_slots_bonus` | `ItemStackIndex` |  | Only affects beacons with BeaconPrototype::quality_affects_module_slots set. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `beacon_power_usage_multiplier` | `float` |  | Must be >= 0. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `beacon_supply_area_distance_bonus` | `float` |  | Only affects beacons with BeaconPrototype::quality_affects_supply_area_distance set. Must be >= 0 and <= 64. *(default: `clamp(`level`, 0, 64)`)* |
| `color` | `Color` |  |  |
| `crafting_machine_energy_usage_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. Only affects crafting machines with CraftingMachinePrototype::quality_affects_energy_usage set. Will be ignored by crafting machines with CraftingMachinePrototype::energy_usage_quality_multiplier set. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `crafting_machine_module_slots_bonus` | `ItemStackIndex` |  | Only affects crafting machines with CraftingMachinePrototype::quality_affects_module_slots set. Will be ignored by crafting machines with CraftingMachinePrototype::module_slots_quality_bonus set. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `crafting_machine_speed_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. Will be ignored by crafting machines with CraftingMachinePrototype::crafting_speed_quality_multiplier set. *(default: `Value of `default_multiplier``)* |
| `default_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `1 + 0.3 * `level``)* |
| `draw_sprite_by_default` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `electric_pole_supply_area_distance_bonus` | `float` |  | Must be >= 0. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `electric_pole_wire_reach_bonus` | `float` |  | Must be >= 0. *(default: `2 * `level``)* |
| `equipment_grid_height_bonus` | `int16` |  |  *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `equipment_grid_width_bonus` | `int16` |  |  *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `fluid_wagon_capacity_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. Only affects fluid wagons with FluidWagonPrototype::quality_affects_capacity set. *(default: `Value of `default_multiplier``)* |
| `flying_robot_max_energy_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `1 + `level``)* |
| `icon` | `FileName` |  | Path to the icon file. Only loaded, and mandatory if `icons` is not defined. |
| `icon_size` | `SpriteSizeType` |  | The size of the square icon, in pixels. E.g. `32` for a 32px by 32px icon. Must be larger than `0`. Only loaded if `icons` is not defined. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 64}`)* |
| `icons` | `array[IconData]` |  | Can't be an empty array. |
| `inserter_speed_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `Value of `default_multiplier``)* |
| `inventory_size_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `Value of `default_multiplier``)* |
| `lab_module_slots_bonus` | `ItemStackIndex` |  | Only affects labs with LabPrototype::quality_affects_module_slots set. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `lab_research_speed_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `Value of `default_multiplier``)* |
| `level` | `uint32` |  | Requires Space Age to use level greater than `0`. |
| `logistic_cell_charging_energy_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. *(default: `Value of `default_multiplier``)* |
| `logistic_cell_charging_station_count_bonus` | `uint32` |  | Only affects roboports with RoboportPrototype::charging_station_count_affected_by_quality set. Only affects roboport equipment with RoboportEquipmentPrototype::charging_station_count_affected_by_quality set. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `mining_drill_mining_radius_bonus` | `float` |  | Only affects mining drills with MiningDrillPrototype::quality_affects_mining_radius set. Must be >= 0. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `mining_drill_module_slots_bonus` | `ItemStackIndex` |  | Only affects mining drills with MiningDrillPrototype::quality_affects_module_slots set. *(default: `Value of `level``)* |
| `mining_drill_resource_drain_multiplier` | `float` |  | Must be in range `[0, 1]`. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `name` | `string` |  | Unique textual identification of the prototype. May only contain alphanumeric characters, dashes and underscores. May not exceed a length of 200 characters. Requires Space Age to create prototypes with name other than `normal` or `quality-unknown`. |
| `next` | `QualityID` |  |  |
| `next_probability` | `double` |  | The quality effect of the module is multiplied by this. For example, if a module's quality effect is 0.2 and the current quality's next_probability is 0.1, then the chance to get the next quality item is 2%. Must be in range [0, 1.0]. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `range_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be within `[1, 3]`. Affects the range of attack parameters, e.g. those used by combat robots, units, guns and turrets. *(default: `min(1 + 0.1 * `level`, 3)`)* |
| `science_pack_drain_multiplier` | `float` |  | Must be in range `[0, 1]`. Only affects labs with LabPrototype::uses_quality_drain_modifier set. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `tool_durability_multiplier` | `double` |  | Must be >= 0.01. Affects the durability of tool items like science packs, repair tools and armor. *(default: `1 + `level``)* |

### `SegmentedUnitPrototype` *(extends `SegmentPrototype`)*

Entity composed of multiple segment entities that trail behind the head.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `acceleration_rate` | `double` |  | The acceleration rate when moving from one state to another. Cannot be negative. |
| `attack_parameters` | `AttackParameters` |  | Attack parameters for when a segmented unit is attacking something. |
| `attacking_speed` | `double` |  | The movement speed while attacking, in tiles per tick. Cannot be negative. |
| `enraged_duration` | `MapTick` |  | The number of ticks to remain enraged after last taking damage. |
| `enraged_speed` | `double` |  | The movement speed while enraged, in tiles per tick. Cannot be negative. |
| `hurt_roar` | `Sound` |  | Sound which plays when health ratio drops below any of `hurt_thresholds`. |
| `hurt_thresholds` | `array[float]` |  | Only loaded, and mandatory if `hurt_roar` is defined. |
| `investigating_speed` | `double` |  | The movement speed while investigating, in tiles per tick. Cannot be negative. |
| `patrolling_speed` | `double` |  | The movement speed while patrolling, in tiles per tick. Cannot be negative. |
| `patrolling_turn_radius` | `double` |  | Cannot be negative. *(default: `Value of `turn_radius``)* |
| `revenge_attack_parameters` | `AttackParameters` |  | Attack parameters for when a segmented unit is attacking something in retaliation because the target first attacked it. |
| `roar` | `Sound` |  |  |
| `roar_probability` | `float` |  | The default is 1.0f / (6.0f * 60.0f), average pause between roars is 6 seconds. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0.00277777785}`)* |
| `segment_engine` | `SegmentEngineSpecification` |  | Specification of the segment engine, which should contain a list of the segments that compose the entity's body. |
| `territory_radius` | `uint32` |  | The territory radius in chunks. The chunk in which the entity spawned is included. |
| `ticks_per_scan` | `uint32` |  | The number of ticks between territory scans. Greater values means longer time between scans, which means a slower reaction time. Cannot be `0`. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 120}`)* |
| `turn_radius` | `double` |  | Turn radius, in tiles. Cannot be negative. |
| `turn_smoothing` | `double` |  | Attempts to smooth out tight turns by limiting how quickly the unit can change turning directions. 0 means no turn smoothing, 1 means no turning whatsoever. Must be between 0 and 1. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `vision_distance` | `double` |  | Vision distance, affects scanning radius for enemies to attack. Must be non-negative. Max 100. |

### `ShortcutPrototype` *(extends `Prototype`)*

Definition for a shortcut button in the shortcut bar. This is **not** a custom keybinding (keyboard shortcut), for that see CustomInputPrototype.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `action` | `'toggle-alt-mode' | 'undo' | 'redo' | 'paste' | ...` |  | If this is `"lua"`, on_lua_shortcut is raised when the shortcut is clicked. |
| `associated_control_input` | `string` |  | Name of a custom input or vanilla control. This is **only** used to show the keybind in the tooltip of the shortcut. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `icon` | `FileName` |  | Path to the icon file. Only loaded, and mandatory if `icons` is not defined. |
| `icon_size` | `SpriteSizeType` |  | The size of the square icon, in pixels. E.g. `32` for a 32px by 32px icon. Must be larger than `0`. The base game uses 32px icons for shortcuts. Only loaded if `icons` is not defined. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 64}`)* |
| `icons` | `array[IconData]` |  | Can't be an empty array. |
| `item_to_spawn` | `ItemID` |  | The item to create when clicking on a shortcut with the action set to `"spawn-item"`. The item must have the spawnable flag set. |
| `order` | `Order` |  | Used to order the shortcuts in the quick panel, which replaces the shortcut bar when using a controller (game pad). It is recommended to order modded shortcuts after the vanilla shortcuts. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `small_icon` | `FileName` |  | Path to the icon file. Used in the shortcut selection popup. Only loaded, and mandatory if `small_icons` is not defined. |
| `small_icon_size` | `SpriteSizeType` |  | The size of the small icon, in pixels. E.g. `32` for a 32px by 32px icon. Must be larger than `0`. The base game uses 24px small icons for shortcuts. Only loaded if `small_icons` is not defined. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 64}`)* |
| `small_icons` | `array[IconData]` |  | Can't be an empty array. |
| `style` | `'default' | 'blue' | 'red' | 'green'` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'default'}`)* |
| `technology_to_unlock` | `TechnologyID` |  | The technology that must be researched before this shortcut can be used. Once a shortcut is unlocked in one save file, it is unlocked for all future save files. |
| `toggleable` | `boolean` |  | Must be enabled for the Factorio API to be able to set the toggled state on the shortcut button, see LuaPlayer::set_shortcut_toggled. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `unavailable_until_unlocked` | `boolean` |  | If `true`, the shortcut will not be available until its `technology_to_unlock` is researched, even if it was already researched in a different game. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |

### `StickerPrototype` *(extends `EntityPrototype`)*

Entity that sticks to another entity, and damages/slows it. Stickers can only be attached to UnitPrototype, CharacterPrototype, CarPrototype and SpiderVehiclePrototype.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `animation` | `Animation` |  |  |
| `damage_interval` | `uint32` |  | Interval between application of `damage_per_tick`, in ticks. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `damage_per_tick` | `DamageParameters` |  | Applied every `damage_interval` ticks, so may not necessarily be "per tick". |
| `duration_in_ticks` | `uint32` |  | Must be > 0. |
| `fire_spread_cooldown` | `uint8` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 30}`)* |
| `fire_spread_radius` | `float` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `force_visibility` | `ForceCondition` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'all'}`)* |
| `ground_target` | `boolean` |  | If true, causes the target entity to become "grounded", disabling flight. This only applies to Character entities wearing mech armor. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `hidden` | `True` |  | The `hidden` property of stickers is hardcoded to `true`. |
| `hidden_in_factoriopedia` | `True` |  | The `hidden_in_factoriopedia` property of stickers is hardcoded to `true`. |
| `render_layer` | `RenderLayer` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'object'}`)* |
| `selection_box_type` | `CursorBoxType` |  | Using this property marks the sticker as a "selection sticker", meaning that the selection box will be rendered around the entity when the sticker is on it. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'entity'}`)* |
| `single_particle` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `spread_fire_entity` | `EntityID` |  | If this is given, this sticker is considered a "fire sticker" for some functions, such as BaseAttackParameters::fire_penalty and EntityPrototypeFlags::not-flammable. |
| `stickers_per_square_meter` | `float` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 15}`)* |
| `target_movement_max` | `float` |  | The maximum movement speed for the target. Negative values are ignored. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': -1}`)* |
| `target_movement_max_from` | `float` |  | The maximum movement speed for the target when the sticker is attached. It linearly changes over time to reach `target_movement_max_to`. Negative values are ignored. *(default: `Value of `target_movement_speed``)* |
| `target_movement_max_to` | `float` |  | The maximum movement speed for the target when the sticker expires. It linearly changes over time starting from `target_movement_max_from`. Negative values are ignored. *(default: `Value of `target_movement_speed``)* |
| `target_movement_modifier` | `float` |  | Less than 1 to reduce movement speed, more than 1 to increase it. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `target_movement_modifier_from` | `float` |  | The modifier value when the sticker is attached. It linearly changes over time to reach `target_movement_modifier_to`. *(default: `Value of `target_movement_modifier``)* |
| `target_movement_modifier_to` | `float` |  | The modifier value when the sticker expires. It linearly changes over time starting from `target_movement_modifier_from`. *(default: `Value of `target_movement_modifier``)* |
| `update_effects` | `array[TriggerEffectWithCooldown]` |  | Effects (with cooldowns) to trigger every tick. |
| `use_damage_substitute` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `vehicle_friction_modifier` | `float` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `vehicle_friction_modifier_from` | `float` |  | Works similarly to `target_movement_modifier_from`. *(default: `Value of `vehicle_friction_modifier``)* |
| `vehicle_friction_modifier_to` | `float` |  | Works similarly to `target_movement_modifier_to`. *(default: `Value of `vehicle_friction_modifier``)* |
| `vehicle_speed_max` | `float` |  | The maximum movement speed for vehicles. Negative values are ignored. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': -1}`)* |
| `vehicle_speed_max_from` | `float` |  | The maximum movement speed for vehicles when the sticker is attached. It linearly changes over time to reach `vehicle_speed_max_to`. Negative values are ignored. *(default: `Value of `vehicle_speed_max``)* |
| `vehicle_speed_max_to` | `float` |  | The maximum movement speed for vehicles when the sticker expires. It linearly changes over time starting from `vehicle_speed_max_from`. Negative values are ignored. *(default: `Value of `vehicle_speed_max``)* |
| `vehicle_speed_modifier` | `float` |  | Less than 1 to reduce vehicle speed, more than 1 to increase it. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `vehicle_speed_modifier_from` | `float` |  | Works similarly to `target_movement_modifier_from`. *(default: `Value of `vehicle_speed_modifier``)* |
| `vehicle_speed_modifier_to` | `float` |  | Works similarly to `target_movement_modifier_to`. *(default: `Value of `vehicle_speed_modifier``)* |

### `TipsAndTricksItem` *(extends `PrototypeBase`)*

A tips and tricks entry.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `category` | `string` |  | Name of a TipsAndTricksItemCategory, used for the sorting of this tips and tricks entry. Tips and trick entries are sorted first by category and then by their `order` within that category. *(default: `the `name` of this prototype`)* |
| `dependencies` | `array[string]` |  | An array of names of other tips and tricks items. This tips and tricks entry is only shown to the player once they have marked all dependencies as read. *(default: `none`)* |
| `icon` | `FileName` |  | Path to the icon file. Only loaded if `icons` is not defined. |
| `icon_size` | `SpriteSizeType` |  | The size of the square icon, in pixels. E.g. `32` for a 32px by 32px icon. Must be larger than `0`. Only loaded if `icons` is not defined. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 64}`)* |
| `icons` | `array[IconData]` |  | Can't be an empty array. |
| `image` | `FileName` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `indent` | `uint8` |  | The tips and tricks entry is indented by `indent`×6 spaces. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `is_title` | `boolean` |  | Whether the tip title on the left in the tips and tricks GUI should use the "title_tip_item" style (semi bold font). *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `order` | `Order` |  | Used to order prototypes in inventory, recipes and GUIs. May not exceed a length of 200 characters. *(default: `Value of `name``)* |
| `player_input_method_filter` | `PlayerInputMethodFilter` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'all'}`)* |
| `simulation` | `SimulationDefinition` |  |  |
| `skip_trigger` | `TipTrigger` |  | Condition for never showing the tip notification to the player. |
| `starting_status` | `TipStatus` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 'locked'}`)* |
| `tag` | `string` |  | String to add in front of the tips and trick entries name. Can be anything, the base game tends to use rich text tags for items, e.g. `[item=wooden-chest]` here. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `trigger` | `TipTrigger` |  | Condition for when the tip notification should be shown to the player. |
| `tutorial` | `string` |  | Name of a TutorialDefinition. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |

### `UpgradeItemPrototype` *(extends `SelectionToolPrototype`)*

An upgrade planner. For an entity to be allowed as an upgrade source, it must be minable, may not have "not-upgradable" flag set and may not be hidden. Additionally, the source entity's mining result must not be an item product that is hidden. Min...

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `alt_select` | `SelectionModeData` |  | The SelectionModeData::mode is hardcoded to `"cancel-upgrade"`. The filters are parsed, but then ignored and forced to be empty. |
| `always_include_tiles` | `boolean` |  | This property is hardcoded to `false`. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `draw_label_for_cursor_render` | `boolean` |  | If the item will draw its label when held in the cursor in place of the item count. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `select` | `SelectionModeData` |  | The SelectionModeData::mode is hardcoded to `"upgrade"`. The filters are parsed, but then ignored and forced to be empty. |
| `stack_size` | `1` |  | Count of items of the same name that can be stored in one inventory slot. Must be 1 when the `"not-stackable"` flag is set. |

### `UseEntityInEnergyProductionAchievementPrototype` *(extends `AchievementPrototype`)*

This prototype is used for receiving an achievement when the player produces energy by entity.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `consumed_condition` | `ItemIDFilter` |  | This item need to be consumed before gaining the achievement. |
| `entity` | `EntityID` |  | This entity is needed to produce energy, for the player to complete the achievement. |
| `produced_condition` | `ItemIDFilter` |  | This item needs to be produced before gaining the achievement. |
| `required_to_build` | `EntityID` |  | This item need to be built before gaining the achievement. |

### `UseItemAchievementPrototype` *(extends `AchievementPrototype`)*

This prototype is used for receiving an achievement when the player uses a capsule.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `amount` | `uint32` |  | How many capsules need to be used. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `limit_quality` | `QualityID` |  |  |
| `limited_to_one_game` | `boolean` |  | If this is false, the player carries over their statistics from this achievement through all their saves. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `to_use` | `ItemID` |  | This will trigger the achievement, if this capsule is used. |

### `ValvePrototype` *(extends `EntityWithOwnerPrototype`)*

A passive device that provides limited control of fluid flow between pipelines.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `animations` | `Animation4Way` |  |  |
| `flow_rate` | `FluidAmount` |  | The max flow rate through the valve per tick. |
| `fluid_box` | `FluidBox` |  | Must have at least one `"output"` FluidFlowDirection and at least one `"input-output"` FluidFlowDirection. |
| `frozen_patch` | `Sprite4Way` |  |  |
| `mode` | `ValveMode` |  |  |
| `threshold` | `float` |  | Ignored if ValvePrototype::mode is `"one-way"`. Must be between `0` and `1` inclusive. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |

---

### `VehiclePrototype` *(extends `EntityWithOwnerPrototype`)* *(abstract)*

Abstract base of all vehicles.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `allow_passengers` | `boolean` |  | Determines whether this vehicle accepts passengers. This includes both drivers and gunners, if applicable. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': True}`)* |
| `allow_remote_driving` | `boolean` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': False}`)* |
| `braking_power` | `Energy | double` |  | Must be positive. There is no functional difference between the two ways to set braking power/force. |
| `chunk_exploration_radius` | `uint32` |  | In chunks. The radius of the radar range of the vehicle, so how many chunks it charts around itself. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0}`)* |
| `crash_trigger` | `TriggerEffect` |  |  |
| `deliver_category` | `string` |  | Name of a DeliverCategory. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': ''}`)* |
| `energy_per_hit_point` | `double` |  | The (movement) energy used per hit point (1 hit point = 1 health damage) taken and dealt for this vehicle during collisions. The smaller the number, the more damage this vehicle and the rammed entity take during collisions: `damage = energy / ener... |
| `equipment_grid` | `EquipmentGridID` |  | The name of the EquipmentGridPrototype this vehicle has. |
| `friction` | `double` |  | Must be positive. There is no functional difference between the two ways to set friction force. |
| `impact_speed_to_volume_ratio` | `double` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 5.0}`)* |
| `minimap_representation` | `Sprite` |  | The sprite that represents this vehicle on the map/minimap. |
| `selected_minimap_representation` | `Sprite` |  | The sprite that represents this vehicle on the map/minimap when it is selected. |
| `stop_trigger` | `TriggerEffect` |  |  |
| `stop_trigger_speed` | `double` |  |  *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 0.0}`)* |
| `terrain_friction_modifier` | `float` |  | Must be in the [0, 1] interval. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 1}`)* |
| `weight` | `double` |  | Must be positive. Weight of the entity used for physics calculation when car hits something. |

### `VirtualSignalPrototype` *(extends `Prototype`)*

A virtual signal.

**Properties:**

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `icon` | `FileName` |  | Path to the icon file that is used to represent this virtual signal. Only loaded, and mandatory if `icons` is not defined. |
| `icon_size` | `SpriteSizeType` |  | The size of the square icon, in pixels. E.g. `32` for a 32px by 32px icon. Must be larger than `0`. Only loaded if `icons` is not defined. *(default: `{'complex_type': 'literal', 'value': 64}`)* |
| `icons` | `array[IconData]` |  | The icon that is used to represent this virtual signal. Can't be an empty array. |

## 8. RCON-Specific Notes

These notes apply to Lua executed via RCON (`/silent-command`) in this project:

- **`game.player` is `nil`** in RCON context — use `game.connected_players[1]` instead.
- **`rcon.print(value)`** is the *only* mechanism to return data from an RCON command. All service methods format a JSON string and pass it here.
- **`/silent-command`** suppresses chat echo; use instead of `/c`.
- **`storage.*`** persists data across RCON calls within the same game session (used for `walk_state`, `chat_log`).
- **`script.on_event()`** registers persistent event handlers from RCON (e.g. `on_tick` for walking, `on_console_chat` for chat capture).
- **Serialisation:** Lua tables must be serialised manually via string concatenation (no `json` library in vanilla Factorio Lua).

### Common RCON Patterns

```lua
-- Get player position
local p = game.connected_players[1]
rcon.print('{"x":' .. p.position.x .. ',"y":' .. p.position.y .. '}')
```
